info.title: Payroll and HR REST API
info.description:
Local Express backend with MySQL and a React SPA.

**Login:** POST /auth/login sends an email OTP; POST /auth/verify-otp returns the JWT. Click Authorize and paste the JWT without a Bearer prefix. No real credentials or tokens are embedded in this documentation.

**Roles:** ADMIN manages payroll, accounts and settings; HR manages employee records, unlocked attendance and hours-only reports; EMPLOYEE uses own account/payslips. Permissions remain enforced on all API calls.

**Payroll:** attendance -> calculate draft -> edit draft if needed -> calculate month tax -> approve (Complete) -> generate payslip -> mark Paid. Reopen Complete before corrections; Paid is immutable.

**Identifiers:** employee id is a numeric database key; employee_id in directory responses is a business code such as E002. Each operation documents which to use. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD; payroll months use YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-01; durations are decimal hours. Database DECIMAL columns may return strings. Some legacy database rows contain additional fields.

**Reports:** daily and monthly endpoints return JSON. PDF download occurs in the SPA. Swagger Try it out executes real API calls when you choose Execute; use a test account/database for demonstrations.

post.summary: Verify password and send email OTP
post.description:
Public endpoint.

Step 1 only: this response does not contain a token. Requires a linked employee email and SMTP configuration. OTP expires after 10 minutes. Login and OTP attempts are rate limited.

post.summary: Verify email OTP and issue a JWT
post.description:
Public endpoint.

Step 2: use the latest emailed code. On success it is consumed and a 24-hour access token is returned. The database account must still be active.

Public endpoint.

Returns the same generic response for unknown/inactive accounts. Reset links expire in 15 minutes; they are not access tokens.

Public endpoint.

Use the token from the emailed link, not the email OTP or login JWT. Invalidates previous sessions and reset links.

get.summary: Read employee and department report filters
Read daily or monthly report data
get.description:
Allowed roles: ADMIN, HR

Returns JSON, not a PDF attachment. Frontend Reports exports this data as PDF. HR may request attendance, overtime or daily-attendance only; salary/rate fields are removed. Monthly filters require year and month. Daily attendance requires date, includes saved records only, does not infer absences, and uses current employee departments. Working hours include overtime. Empty results return rows: [].

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Required only for daily-attendance. A real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date.
